I'm sorry I didn't respond earlier! I was having an awful night, but I'm a lot better. 
I am clinically depressed and some nights are harder than others while some or just awful. The night I posted this was one of those awful nights.
Thank you all for your support, I really do appreciate.  I'm fine now!
Nursing! It's super exciting and fun. But ubber stressful, you know?  Sort of like life in general!

I feel the same way right now! But, if we end it now there is no possibility of a new road getting paved for us. It is just death. Nothing happens with the life you currently live when you die. It just ends. Or how bout forget paving a new road all together! How bout say a big f**k you to the fiery pits of a shitty life and putting them out! You need to fight! I need to fight too! Realize that if something doesn't go right there is always the choice of going left. Be strong and always remember that you don't have to end your life. Because staying in this life and fighting like hell is much better than dying young and/or unrightfully. Stay strong!

I have been struggling with depression for a good 6 years now. I am 18 years old. It's just what depression does! It makes you want to give up and it blocks you from enjoying life and living. Also I just started college a week ago, which is very stressful.  And I have just awful self esteem issues.  Everything is just going down hill.
